dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped markings are present along the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by high-contrast light-colored perimeters with irregular, serrated edges that enclose darker interior fur. The gradient transition is sharp between the light boundary and the dark charcoal base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters is visible on the posterior lateral flank and near the pelvic region. These blobs lack an internal gradient and appear as a stippled texture rather than defined rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle. A secondary linear relationship is observed between a series of four high-intensity blobs following the longitudinal axis of the lower lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive contrast between the light-colored vibrissae pads and the dark-pigmented periorbital and snout region.
